All hired employees are expected to have experience with Microsoft Copilot and / or an approved equivalent AI solution. 

 Description
 Data Systems Analysts, Inc (DSA) has an opening for a Software Developer to support the Organizational Messaging Service (OMS) National Gateway Centers’ (NGCs) Command and Control (C2) Messaging Interoperability mission. This role implements mission critical software features to meet customer requirements in a timely basis.  The developer will maintain existing software and develop code for new requirements. 
 

 Required Qualifications
 

 
 All hired employees are expected to have experience with Microsoft Copilot and / or an approved equivalent AI solution 

 Must hold an IAT II qualified certification (example Security+, CSSLP).

 Bachelor of Arts /Bachelor of Science (BA/BS) in an Information Technology or Computer Science discipline.

 Three years of professional programming experience. JavaScript preferred. Java is a plus.

 
 Clearance Required 

 
 Must be able to obtain a DOD Top Secret Clearance with SCI Eligibility

 
 Desired Qualifications
 

 
 Web programming experience. Angular framework a plus.

 Experience with UI design and UI prototyping.

 Experience with using Linux as a software development environment.

 Experience with version control software; GIT knowledge is a plus.

 Exposure to automated testing and CI/CD a plus.

 Configuration management & technical documentation.

 
 Key Responsibilities
 

 
 Maintaining existing software and developing code for new requirements.

 Writing tests for test-driven development.

 Daily standup meetings, development actions, checking code into configuration management system, peer reviews.

 Implement mission critical software features to meet customer requirements in a timely basis.

 
   

  

 #dsa209

 #LI-KE1
 The posted salary range is a good-faith estimate. Actual compensation will be based on the selected candidate’s qualifications, experience, skills, and other job-related factors. 
 

 DSA - Salary Pay Range
 $100,000 — $120,000 USD 


 Many of DSA's positions require the ability to obtain a security clearance. Security clearances may only be granted to U.S. citizens. In addition, applicants who accept a conditional offer of employment may be subject to government security investigation(s) and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. DSA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. DSA is committed to treating all employees and applicants for employment with respect and dignity and maintaining a workplace that is free from unlawful discrimination. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected status. DSA requires background checks , where permitted , by law. DSA is an E-Verify Employer.
